part.text: The formatter currently casts every input to an unsigned type before `write_int`, so negative values become their two’s-complement magnitude. The existing regression assertions already cover the intended output; I’ll align the call with the normal signed integer path.

part.text:
Fixed `fmt::group_digits` for signed negative integers in `include/fmt/format.h`.

The formatter now uses the existing `make_write_int_arg` path to derive both the absolute magnitude and sign prefix, so `fmt::group_digits(-12345)` formats as `-12,345` while preserving explicit comma grouping and width/sign behavior.

Validation completed in the provided container:

```sh
cmake --build build --target format-test -j2
./build/bin/format-test
```

Result: all 123 `format-test` tests passed. `git diff --check` also passed.
